entries.title: Quinn's first exhibition
entries.content: Quinn showed photographs for the first time in a small gallery downtown. Two sold, and she keeps the invitation in her wallet.
entries.author: kin

entries.title: Marta, the older sister
entries.content: Marta is Alexi's older sister. She lives in Lisbon, calls every Sunday and still uses Alexi's childhood nickname.

entries.title: The night at the cabin
entries.content: Rain and Alexi spent a night at a mountain cabin. They played cards by the fireplace and shared a bottle of Quantum Tequila nobody remembers buying.

entries.title: The Solara lighthouse
entries.content: Solara is a fictional seaside town of white houses. Its old lighthouse still works, and the harbour market opens before sunrise.
